//: Agent worktrees (`.claude/worktrees/agent-*/`) are full checkouts of this repository at some other commit. Without these excludes VS Code indexes them as if they were project sources: the TypeScript server type-checks stale copies, and their errors show up in the Problems panel attributed to files that may no longer exist on any branch (observed after PR #374 — 14 `ts(2339)` errors from a worktree whose code had already been fixed on main). They are also invisible to `git status`, so nothing else warns you. Excluding them costs nothing: the agent that owns a worktree runs its own checks inside it.
